title: Sum of inverse sizes over long paths
statement: Let $P$ be a finite list of paths, where the length of a path is the number of coordinates assigned along it, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The sum of $2^{-	ext{length}(p)}$ over paths $p$ in the list with length greater than $k$ is at most the length of the list times $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of paths on the $n$-coordinate Boolean cube
